about: Hand decisions about ME1 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing (scripts/msh/gridbooks.py reads this book). Every one was read off the page image; none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and a few words of a label - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header}: the printed page in the entry's own booklet, and the start of the entry's header
{summary}: a Pregenerated Heroes Summary row (PDF 51), by the name the chart prints
verdict   misprint          the book prints a value its own arithmetic contradicts; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the rules give
as_printed        the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, and the note says why

rows              the grid prints fewer than seven rows; 'abilities' are its rows as the page gives them, a row it does not print as null, and 'corrected' is how that row is played; health, karma, resources and popularity as printed, because a grid the parser cannot read leaves them welded to its rows
summary_misprint  the chart prints a value its own ranks contradict and the character's block does not; 'printed' is the chart's, 'corrected' the block's
checked   the date the page image was read

overrides.note: One line stands for Reason, Intuition and Psyche: an Oolafat's mind is Ego's. Health 50 = 10 + 10 + 10 + 20; Karma is printed 0, so the three are played as Shift 0, as MHSP1's Lockheed's printed ? Reason is.

50 is Amazing. Health 400 = 150 + 50 + 100 + 100 agrees with the number. The block also prints Karma 0 against R 100 + I 100 + P 100 = 300; that is kept as printed, as MA1's Miss Locke and Mr. Chambers are, because one override covers one block.
275 is inside Shift Y's range (176-350, ranks.json), not its standard 200. Health 575 = 275 + 100 + 100 + 100 uses the 275.
The chart's own row gives R 30 + I 50 + P 30 = 110, and Firelord's block (Adventure p.5) prints 110.
